product.title: Marietas Islands Snorkel Tour & Hidden Beach

description.text: In Puerto Vallarta, this snorkeling day heads to the Marietas Islands with a published chance of entering Hidden Beach through the water tunnel when park conditions allow. Snorkel gear, life vests, drinking water, snacks, and national-park permits are included so the group can stay with the reefs rather than paying separate conservation windows. Dolphins, turtles, and tropical fish are the usual marine highlights on the published route. Private departures can be arranged on request, but the listed product is a guided boat outing rather than a self-guided rental. The format suits visitors who want a Marietas day without coordinating park fees and boat timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Puerto Vallarta, and the itinerary stays on the islands and Hidden Beach rather than adding extra bay villages.

highlights: Explore the Marieta Islands with a chance to see Hidden Beach
Discover a variety of marine life with provided snorkel gear
National park fees, snacks, and bottled water are provided
Private tours can be organized on request

start.description: Meet at the confirmed Puerto Vallarta or Punta de Mita boat departure listed when booking.

end.description: Return to your Puerto Vallarta meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
